description: The Dark Energy Spectroscopic Instrument has created the largest 3D map of the Universe, charting millions of galaxies. Early results suggest dark energy may evolve over time, challenging long-held cosmological theories.
title: Scientists Just Created the Largest 3D Map of the Universe Ever to Study Dark Energy

description: Marathon, the latest extraction FPS from Destiny maker Bungie, is one of the most hardcore shooters out in the market right now. It is tough-as-nails, immersive, and intense. And it features perhaps the most robust and satisfactory first-person shooting experience among its peers.
title: Marathon Review: Bungie's Serious, Stylish Extraction FPS Is One of the Best Shooters in Years

description: Counterpoint Research’s Monthly India Smartphone Tracker report shows that India’s smartphone shipments fell 3 percent YoY in Q1 2026. Vivo led India’s smartphone market in Q1 2026 with a 21 percent share. Samsung came in second place, while Oppo retained third position. Nothing emerged as the fastest-growing smartphone brand with 47 percent YoY growth.
title: Indian Smartphone Shipments Dropped to Six-Year Low in Q1 2026 as Vivo Topped Market, Nothing Led Growth: Counterpoint

description: Vivo X300 FE will go on sale in India in two variants, a tipster claims. The handset will reportedly be available for purchase in 12GB + 256GB  and 12GB + 512GB RAM and storage configurations. On top of this, the leaker has shared a purported image of the smartphone with the 200mm 2G2 telephoto extender kit attached to its back. The image shows that the kit will feature the Zeiss branding on the back. The kit will reportedly be sold separately in the country. This comes shortly after the company confirmed that the Vivo X300 FE and Vivo X300 Ultra will be launched soon in India.
title: Vivo X300 FE Storage Options Leaked Alongside Live Image With Telephoto Extender Kit

description: WhatsApp’s new WhatsApp Message History feature was launched by the instant messaging platform on February 20. The feature solves a significant problem where newly added group members were not able to read and access previous messages sent in the group, leading to confusion. However, the functionality lets WhatsApp group admins send message history to new members. If you’re a group admin, you can help the new people you add understand what has previously been discussed by enabling message history. The feature is available for most users on Android and iOS.
title: How to Send WhatsApp Message History in a Group on Android and iOS: A Step-by-Step Guide

description: Ethereum-based NFT platform Foundation is shutting down after a planned acquisition by Blackdove fell through. The move reflects ongoing challenges in the NFT market, even as trading activity continues. Users will be allowed to withdraw and delist assets before the platform fully ceases operations.
title: Ethereum NFT Platform Shuts Down After Blacklove Sale Falls Through

description: Honor 600 Pro and Honor 600 will be powered by Qualcomm’s Snapdragon 8 Elite and Snapdragon 7 Gen 4 chipsets globally, respectively, the company revealed on Friday. The smartphones have been listed on the company’s website, revealing key details about the two phones. The Pro model will be equipped with a triple rear camera unit, led by a 200-megapixel main shooter, a 50-megapixel periscope telephoto camera, and a 12-megapixel ultrawide camera. On the other hand, the Honor 600 will feature a dual rear camera unit, sporting the same primary and ultrawide cameras as the Pro model.
title: Honor 600 Pro and Honor 600 Key Specifications, Features Revealed via Official Listing

description: Canva introduced a major upgrade to its artificial intelligence (AI) suite on Thursday. Dubbed Canva AI 2.0, the new suite brings an agentic system that understands layered design and can complete complex tasks using a conversational interface. The suite was first previewed at the Canva Create 2026 event, which was hosted at Hollywood Park in Los Angeles, California.
title: Canva Introduces Canva AI 2.0, Brings Agentic Capabilities and Memory to Perform Design Tasks

description: Nvidia GeForce Now has officially made its way to India, nearly a decade after its global introduction. It signals a significant step for cloud gaming in the country, following the establishment of a GeForce RTX-powered data centre in India in 2025. As high-end gaming hardware remains expensive and often out of reach for many users, Nvidia’s cloud gaming service aims to bridge this gap by allowing players to stream games directly via cloud, eliminating hardware limitations. Introduced as a subscription-based service, it offers support for AAA titles and RTX-enabled graphics.
title: GeForce Now Explained: What is it, Features, Subscriptions, and More

description: Oppo has already confirmed that the Find X9s Pro will launch in China next week. Now, key specifications of the phone have leaked online. It will have a Hasselblad-tuned dual 200-megapixel rear camera setup, alongside the LUMO imaging system. The leak suggests that the primary 200-megapixel HPE camera will use a 1/1.4-inch sensor, while the 200-megapixel periscope telephoto camera could use a 1/1.56-inch HP5 sensor with 2.8x optical zoom. It is said to use a 7,025mAh battery. The brand has already confirmed that the Oppo Find X9s Pro will have a 6.32-inch display.
title: Oppo Find X9s Pro Key Specifications Surface Online as Launch Date Draws Closer

description: Grinex has halted trading after losing $13.4 million in a cyberattack suspected to involve highly sophisticated actors. The incident has raised concerns over security and compliance, especially as the exchange faces scrutiny due to its links with previously sanctioned platforms.
title: Russian-Based Crypto Exchange Grinex Halts Operation After $14 Million Hack

description: MediaTek’s next-generation flagship chipset, the Dimensity 9600 Pro, is rumoured to rival the purported Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 6 Pro. While the Taiwanese chipmaker has yet to reveal any details about the SoC, a recent leak sheds light on the performance gains it could offer over its current-generation chip, the Dimensity 9500. It is tipped to deliver peak clock speeds of up to 5GHz, achieving a multi-core score between 12,000 and 12,500 points in benchmarks.
title: MediaTek Dimensity 9600 Pro Leak Suggests 5GHz Clock Speed, High Benchmark Scores

description: Sony’s tenth-generation gaming console, ubiquitously known as the PlayStation 6 (PS6), has been in the rumour mill for quite some time now, offering an early glimpse at what it could bring to the table. A recent leak suggests the PS6 may deliver more substantial improvements in specific areas, such as ray tracing, over the PS5 and PS5 Pro. It is also tipped to offer major enhancements in terms of AI-driven graphics, improving upon Sony’s recently introduced PSSR technology.
title: PS6 Leak Suggests 'Massive' Graphics Leap With AI, 10x Ray Tracing Boost; Might Offer PS4, PS5 Compatibility

description: OpenAI, on Thursday, released a major update to Codex, its coding-focused platform for desktop. The new update brings computer use, image generation, native access to the web, and other personalisation tools to users, significantly upgrading the usability of the tool. The new features are first arriving on macOS and will be rolled out to Windows and the integrated development environment (IDE) soon.
title: OpenAI Upgrades Codex With Computer Use, Image Generation Capabilities

description: Youth (2026) is a Telugu romantic drama that follows the journey of Praveen, a carefree teenager navigating love, family expectations, and self-growth. Directed by Ken Karunas, the film portrays the emotional struggles of adolescence through his relationship with Saroja and his personal transformation. With engaging twists and relatable themes, Youth connects well with modern audiences and is now available to stream on Netflix.
title: Youth (2026) Now Available for Streaming Online: Everything You Need to Know About This Romantic Drama

description: The Asus Zenbook S14 features a premium and compact design language. The laptop features a 14-inch 3K OLED display with a 120Hz screen refresh rate. The device is powered by an Intel Core Ultra 9 processor and an Intel NPU with up to 50 TOPS performance. Check out the first impressions to know more about the latest Asus Zenbook S14.
title: Asus Zenbook S14 (2026) First Impressions

description: OnePlus Watch 4 has appeared on the Google Play Console and EEC, hinting at an imminent launch. The listing suggests a Snapdragon W5 chipset, 2GB RAM, and a 466 x 466 display, likely around 1.5 inches. It may run WearOS 5.0 and pack a 646mAh battery. Retail box leaks confirm model number OPWWE261, Android 9 support, and 10W charging. The smartwatch may be a rebranded Oppo Watch X3, which is priced at EUR 379 (roughly Rs. 41,500).
title: OnePlus Watch 4 Reportedly Listed on Google Play Console With Snapdragon W5 Chip

description: Android 17 Beta 4's APK teardown reportedly reveal a new feature codenamed “orbit.” It is said to mention an upcoming notification feature called Pixel Glow. This could use "subtle light and colour" to alert users when their phone is placed face down. The phone could show lighting effects for incoming calls and when interacting with Gemini. The feature is expected to make its way to the Pixel 11 series smartphones.
title: Google's Pixel Phones Could Support Pixel Glow Notification Feature Once Again, Android 17 APK Teardown Shows

description: Vivo Y600 Pro will be launched in China soon, as the smartphone maker has started teasing its debut. As part of the announcement, the tech firm has revealed the design of the phone. The handset appears in a purple colour option. It is teased to feature a circular rear camera module, housing camera lenses. Moreover, it is confirmed to be equipped with a 10,000mAh battery. The upcoming Vivo Y600 Pro will also boast a 50-megapixel primary rear camera, featuring an Aspheric “premium” lens. The phone will succeed last year’s Vivo Y500 Pro, which features a dual rear camera unit, led by a 200-megapixel shooter.
title: Vivo Y600 Pro Confirmed to Launch Soon With Significantly Larger 10,000mAh Battery

description: Assassin's Creed: Black Flag Resynced will reportedly release on July 9, 2026. According to a new report, Ubisoft has pushed the official announcement to next week. The Black Flag remake will reportedly not be an RPG. The original Assassin's Creed IV: Black Flag released in 2013.
title: Assassin's Creed: Black Flag Resynced Will Reportedly Release in July, Reveal Set for Next Week

description: Samsung will reportedly adopt the UFS 5.0 storage to select models in the Galaxy S27 series. The decision is said to be influenced by rising costs and production challenges. Despite this shift, the base storage configurations are expected to remain unchanged. This suggests that the UFS 5.0 will be used in the flagship Galaxy S27 Ultra. For comparison, the Galaxy S26 Ultra was launched with UFS 4.0 storage.
title: Samsung Galaxy S27 Series Tipped to Debut With UFS 5.0 Storage, But Only Select Models Might Get Upgraded

description: Amazfit Cheetah 2 Pro has launched in the US at $449.99 (roughly Rs. 49,100) as a smartwatch focused on runners and fitness users. It features a titanium build with sapphire glass, a 1.32-inch AMOLED display, and dual-band GPS. The watch supports Zepp Coach training plans, advanced running metrics, and over 170 sports modes. It also offers health tracking features such as heart rate, SpO2, and sleep monitoring, along with up to 20 days of claimed battery life.
title: Amazfit Cheetah 2 Pro Launched With 1.32-Inch AMOLED Screen, Up to 20-Day Battery Life: Price, Features

description: Directed by Ramesh Indira, Pochamma is a Telugu Supernatural thriller web series that is now available to stream for the gold subscribers on AhaTamil, in Telugu and Tamil languages.
title: Pochamma Out on OTT: Know When and Where to Stream This Original Series Online

description: Bitcoin traded near $74,600 on Friday, holding within a narrow range as mixed ETF flows and macro uncertainty limited upside. Institutional demand remains present but inconsistent, while altcoins show selective participation. Analysts say the market remains consolidation-driven, with key resistance near $75,000.
title: Bitcoin Holds Near $74,600, Ethereum Trades Around $2,300 as ETF Flows Remain Inconsistent

description: Apple has announced the retirement of a senior marketing executive responsible for the Apple Watch, AirPods, health and smart home products, signalling a changing of the guard. Stan Ng, a 31-year Apple veteran, said on Thursday he is leaving. He helped create the first Apple Watch and later guided newer models and major accessories during his long career there.
title: Apple Marketing Chief for Watch, AirPods, Home and Health Retires After 31 Years

description: Google announced upgrades to AI Mode in Google Chrome on Thursday. As per the Mountain View-based tech giant, the new features are aimed at making search more fluid and context-aware. Google is integrating search and browsing more closely. This allows users to interact with web pages and AI-generated responses side-by-side. With the latest changes, AI Mode will be able to pull up context from multiple sources for more contextual responses.
title: Google Chrome Gets AI Mode Update With Side-by-Side Browsing, Contextual Search Tools

description: The OTT platforms have landed with a new set of movies and series, including Toaster, Assi, Matka King, and more.
title: OTT Releases This Week (April 13 - April 19): Toaster, Matka King, Assi, Euphoria Season 3, Ustaad Bhagat Singh, and More

description: Ala Chere Seetha Ramuni Chentaku is a Telugu romantic drama that explores deep emotional love and destiny.
title: Ala Chere Seetha Ramuni Chentaku Now Streaming Online: Where to Watch, Plot, Cast, and More

description: OnePlus Europe is currently reviewing its “regional roadmap and product strategy” in Europe, according to a report citing Klaus Wichmand, the Senior Community Manager at OnePlus Europe. Wichmand, in a post on LinkedIn, which has since been deleted, said that the employees of OnePlus’ European arm have begun looking for new jobs, including him. This has prompted speculations that the company could soon wind up its operations in the region, halting product launches in the EU. This comes soon after Robin Liu, former OnePlus India Chief Executive Officer (CEO), left the reins of the company in the country, reportedly moving back to China.
title: OnePlus Employees in Europe Preparing to Leave as Firm Reviews Regional Roadmap: Report

description: Anthropic, on Thursday, released another major update to its Opus model, dubbed Claude Opus 4.7. The new artificial intelligence (AI) model comes just days after the San Francisco-based startup released Claude Mythos, a model which is so capable at cybersecurity tasks that the company has limited its access. Opus 4.7 is built using the same architecture but has been intentionally kept less advanced to ensure that it cannot be used to carry out cyberattacks.
title: Anthropic Releases Claude Opus 4.7 AI Model, Calls It Less Advanced Than Claude Mythos

description: Vivo X300 Ultra and Vivo X300 FE will be launched in India soon, the Chinese smartphone maker confirmed on Friday. Along with the teaser, the tech firm has also revealed the design of the upcoming smartphones. The Vivo X300 Ultra, the company’s upcoming flagship smartphone, will sport a round rear camera module, housing four cameras. Moreover, it is also teased to ship with support for Vivo’s external telephoto converter kit. Additionally, the dedicated microsites for the two phones are now live on Flipkart and the Vivo India online store, confirming their availability via the websites.
title: Vivo X300 Ultra and Vivo X300 FE India Launch and Design Teased: Expected Specifications, Features

description: Developer 4A Games and publisher Deep Silver have revealed Metro 2039, the fourth mainline entry in the Metro series. The first-person shooter will launch on PC, PS5, and Xbox Series S/X in winter 2026. 4A games is promising the darkest game in the series yet. Metro 2039 will feature a new fully voiced protagonist and a story-driven, single-player campaign.
title: 4A Games Reveal Metro 2039 With New Protagonist and the Series' Darkest Story Yet; Launch Set for Winter 2026

description: Huawei’s Watch Fit 5 series has leaked ahead of launch, revealing pricing, features, and specifications. The Watch Fit 5 may cost EUR 199 (roughly Rs. 21,800), while the Pro variant could start at EUR 299 (roughly Rs. 32,700). Both models are expected to offer AMOLED displays, GPS, NFC, and multiple sensors, with the Pro adding LTPO OLED, ECG, and diving support. The series may include premium materials, fitness tracking features, and up to 10 days of battery life.
title: Huawei Watch Fit 5, Watch Fit 5 Pro Price and Features Leak Online Ahead of Anticipated Launch

description: Samsung Galaxy A27 is expected to go official soon as a successor to last year's Galaxy A26. New leak now hints at its design. The newly leaked CAD renders show the phone with a hole-punch design. It appears to have a triple rear camera unit.  The Galaxy A27 is expected to ship with a Snapdragon 6 Gen 3 chipset and a 12-megapixel front-facing camera.
title: Samsung Galaxy A27 Renders Indicate a Hole Punch Display Cutout Is Finally Coming; Triple Rear Cameras Expected

description: The Dell Pro Plus Earbuds clearly prioritise work over everything else. They handle calls really well, keep connections stable, and switch between devices without any fuss, especially with the USB receiver. They also stay comfortable through long hours, and the app adds a few genuinely useful features for meetings. Battery life holds up well and stays close to Dell’s claims. These make the most sense if your day revolves around calls and meetings rather than music.
title: Dell Pro Plus Earbuds Review: Call Me, Maybe?
Flipkart Fitness Carnival is Live | Time to Upgrade Your Fitness Game

description: DJI Osmo Pocket 4 was launched globally on Thursday as the latest model in its compact vlogging camera lineup. The new handheld action camera brings several upgrades over its predecessor, including a larger sensor, improved stabilisation, and better video capabilities. The company claims it has been designed for creators and vloggers, and brings features aimed at delivering better image quality and more flexible shooting options, while maintaining the portable form factor.
title: DJI Osmo Pocket 4 Launched With 1-Inch CMOS Sensor, Improved Gimbal Stabilisation: Price, Specifications
Samsung Galaxy S26 Ultra: Built to Make AI Feel Effortless

description: Intel Core Series 3 CPUs were launched in the global markets on Thursday. The new compute platform is built on the Intel 18A semiconductor process and caters to computing for schools, small businesses, and value buyers. Intel Core Series 3 has been dubbed the company’s first AI-ready Core Series chip, which can support AI workloads up to 40 trillion operations per second (TOPS). It is claimed to support up to two integrated Thunderbolt 4 ports, Intel Wi-Fi 7 (R2), and Intel Bluetooth 6.
title: Intel Core Series 3 Processors Launched With Xe3 GPU, 40 TOPS AI Compute: Availability, Specifications
